notices.title: About this service
description: RDAP.org aims to support users and developers of RDAP clients by providing a "bootstrap server", i.e. single end point for RDAP queries.
RDAP.org aggregates information about all known RDAP servers. RDAP clients can send RDAP queries to RDAP.org, which will then redirect requests to the appropriate RDAP service.
